Rounding: amounts are rounded half-up to 2 decimals per line, not on the invoice total (policy §7.3).

cases.label: acceptable
cases.justification: n4 repeats part of n2 (10% annual prepayment, §6.1); n2 keeps everything, including the non-combinable condition.

cases.task: Migrate the public API from gateway v1 to gateway v2. Keep the settings that must carry over and the state of the migration steps.

current.body: Rate limit: 100 requests per minute per API key, bursts up to 20 (gateway v1 config, ticket OPS-311).
Migration steps: (1) export v1 keys - done; (2) import keys into v2 - done; (3) replay rate-limit settings into v2 - NOT done; (4) switch DNS - blocked until step 3 is verified.
Exemption: the /health endpoint is not rate-limited (OPS-311).

proposed.body: Rate limit per API key: 100/min with bursts of 20 (v1 config, OPS-311).
Migration steps: (1) export v1 keys - done; (2) import keys into v2 - done; (3) replay rate-limit settings into v2 - NOT done; (4) switch DNS - blocked until step 3 is verified.
/health stays exempt from rate limiting (OPS-311).

cases.label: acceptable
cases.justification: Same values, exemption and ticket reference, in shorter wording.

cases.task: Run the release checklist for version 4.2. Keep the remaining steps and the conditions attached to them.

current.body: Pre-deploy: (a) back up the orders database - required before step (c); (b) run smoke tests on staging - done, all passed.
Deploy: (c) apply migration M-57; (d) roll out to a 10% canary; (e) promote to 100% only after the canary error rate stays below 1% for 30 minutes.
Pre-deploy: (b) staging smoke tests passed.
Rollback plan: revert to 4.1.3 and restore the backup from step (a).

proposed.body: Pre-deploy: (a) back up the orders database - required before step (c); (b) run smoke tests on staging - done, all passed.
Deploy: (c) apply migration M-57; (d) roll out to a 10% canary; (e) promote to 100% after 30 minutes.
Pre-deploy: (b) staging smoke tests passed.
Rollback plan: revert to 4.1.3 and restore the backup from step (a).

cases.label: harmful
cases.lost_text: the canary error rate stays below 1%
cases.justification: The promotion condition loses its error-rate threshold: promotion now depends only on time.
